name: @pipeworx/mcp-uk-gazette

tools.name: gazette_search_notices
tools.description: Search The Gazette — the UK's official public record of statutory notices (London, Edinburgh and Belfast editions, archive back to 1665). Full-text search plus filters for notice category, publication date range, edition, and location. Covers company events (liquidations, administrations, winding-up petitions, name changes), personal insolvency, deceased estates, road/planning orders, honours, state and royal notices. Use for "official UK notices about X", "gazette notices for company Y", "road closure orders near Z". Example: gazette_search_notices({ query: "Tesco", category: "corporate insolvency" })

query.description: Full-text search — company name, person, place, or any words appearing in the notice text

category.description: Notice category — a name like "corporate insolvency", "wills & probate", "road restrictions", or a code from gazette_notice_categories (G-code or legacy 2-digit)

notice_types.description: Advanced: one or more 4-digit notice type codes joined with "+", e.g. "2450" (petitions to wind up)

location.description: UK postcode or town/city name to search around (needs distance_miles, default 5)

tools.name: gazette_insolvency_notices
tools.description: Search official UK insolvency notices in The Gazette — the statutory public record where liquidations, administrations, winding-up petitions and orders, bankruptcy orders, creditors' meetings, and notices to creditors MUST be published. The go-to source for "is UK company X in liquidation/administration", monitoring company distress, or tracking personal bankruptcies. Search by company name or Companies House number (both are indexed). scope narrows to "corporate" or "personal" insolvency. Example: gazette_insolvency_notices({ company: "Wilko", scope: "corporate" })

company.description: Company name, Companies House number, or person name to search

notice_types.description: Advanced: 4-digit notice type codes joined with "+", e.g. "2450" petitions to wind up

tools.name: gazette_deceased_estates
tools.description: Search UK deceased-estates notices in The Gazette (Trustee Act 1925 s.27 notices) — executors advertise a death so creditors and claimants can come forward before the estate is distributed. Used for probate research, tracing an estate, checking whether a death notice was placed, and finding the claim deadline. Filter by name, date of death, claim expiry date, or location. Example: gazette_deceased_estates({ name: "John Smith", died_after: "2026-01-01" })

claim_expires_after.description: Earliest claim-expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD (find estates still open to claims by setting this to today)

location.description: UK postcode or town/city name to search around (needs distance_miles, default 5)

tools.name: gazette_get_notice
tools.description: Get the structured record for one Gazette notice by its ID (from any gazette search tool, or a thegazette.co.uk/notice/<id> URL). Returns the notice type, publication date, gazette edition and issue, companies named (with Companies House numbers), people, addresses with coordinates, related legislation, and key dates. Example: gazette_get_notice({ notice_id: "4123456" })

notice_id.description: Notice ID — numeric (e.g. "4123456") or legacy alphanumeric (e.g. "L-60768-1986497")

tools.name: gazette_notice_categories
tools.description: Browse The Gazette's notice-category taxonomy — the category codes accepted by gazette_search_notices. Optionally filter by a search word. Categories span companies (insolvency, name changes, mergers), people (bankruptcy, deceased estates, honours), environment & infrastructure (planning, roads, property), state/royal/church notices, and money (pensions, coinage). Example: gazette_notice_categories({ search: "insolvency" })

search.description: Optional word to filter category names, e.g. "insolvency", "roads", "probate"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-uk-gazette forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the uk-gazette pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
